newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-KALEV RAISES CP PROGRAMME TO 100 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-KALEV RAISES CP PROGRAMME TO 100 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Confectionary firm Kalev raised its two-year commercial paper programme from 40 million kroons to 100 million kroons, Kalev and Talinvest said on Tuesday.
The programme was increased due to a need for working capital as production has risen, the companies added in a statement.
Kalev will on July 16 issue two series of commercial papers. The first issue, which matures in one month, is worth 12 million kroons and yields 6.45 percent.
The other issue of 50 million kroons matures in three months and yields 8.20 percent.
Both issues were fully subscribed and the issue of three-months papers was oversubscribed 1.5 times, the companies added.
Kalev has issued seven series of commercial papers since last October. The issues were organised by Talinvest.
